description: This file defines the CustomShippingQuoteWeightItem class, which extends CustomShippingQuoteItem and implements JSONAware. It models a shipping quote item with weight and price details, providing JSON serialization functionality.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuoteWeightItem
classes.description: A class representing a custom shipping quote item with weight and price details, capable of serializing to JSON.

methods.name: getPriceText
methods.description: Retrieves the price text associated with the shipping quote item.

methods.name: setPriceText
methods.description: Sets the price text associated with the shipping quote item.

methods.name: setMaximumWeight
methods.description: Sets the maximum weight for this shipping quote item.

methods.name: getMaximumWeight
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum weight for this shipping quote item.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the shipping quote item to a JSON string, including price and maximum weight.
